name: The Last Night
description: Three separate investigations converge on a nighttime operation at the factory.
offerText: Three separate investigations converge on a nighttime operation at the factory.

stages.description: Compare factory, hospital and government evidence; identify the convoy departure.
Reach the restricted factory area during the convoy operation.
Survive the military operation and discover a route beyond the district.

_codex.narrativeIntent: Three separate investigations converge on a nighttime operation at the factory.
implementationNotes: Unlock only when all three branch finales are complete, regardless of order.
Use world-object interaction for factory entry; current dialogue triggers are compatibility stubs.
Incident reveals a massive creature but does not explain the larger origin of the outbreak.
After incident set escape_routes_unlocked; Titan strange-key route and Pavel permit route are alternatives.
If Dusan arrested, his workshop is closed but maintenance access remains obtainable through discovered notes.
If Milena detained, optional rescue can occur during convoy chaos; do not hard-lock ending.
_codex.compatibility: _codex is design metadata, not an executable trigger. Keep all original IDs, trigger shapes, rewards, and existing save compatibility. Add runtime support only after implementing the documented systems.
